source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Progressive bradykinesia together with another parkinsonian motor feature such as rigidity or resting tremor.","B":"Rapidly ascending symmetric weakness with areflexia and progression over days rather than a chronic parkinsonian movement pattern.","C":"Isolated cognitive decline without bradykinesia, rigidity, resting tremor, or another progressive motor abnormality.","D":"Sudden episodic unilateral weakness with complete recovery and no persistent or progressive movement abnormality."}}
source_row.rationale: NINDS describes Parkinson disease as a progressive movement disorder with common motor features including bradykinesia, rigidity and resting tremor.
